items.quote: They have turned aside quickly out of the way which I commanded them: they have made them a molten calf, and have worshipped it, and have sacrificed thereunto
items.claim: The people quickly turned aside from God's commanded way and made a molten calf to worship and sacrifice to
items.action: turned aside quickly / made / worshipped / sacrificed
items.mechanism: making a molten calf, worshipping it, sacrificing to it
